english.meaning: to turn something around; to look at it the other way round
english.note: 換轉來講 means looking at it the other way round.

exampleSentences.english: So, in other words, if they get good results but society doesn’t hype them up so much...
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉如果換轉來講，佢哋攞到好成績，但係社會人士冇即係咁大力渲染嘅話。
